sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Attacks without a weapon use Strength or Finesse and deal Proficiency d4 physical damage on a success.
When: Use when a PC punches, kicks, tackles, or otherwise attacks without a listed weapon.
Not When: Do not invent a larger damage die unless a feature or table ruling grants one.
Question: Can I hit them without a weapon?
Answer: Yes. Use Strength or Finesse as fits the fiction, then roll Proficiency d4 damage on a hit.
Example: Garrick shoulder-checks a skeleton away from the Custodian.
Aliases: unarmed punch kick improvised punch
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
